svg.title: Barista — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as barista, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A rounded portafilter with a long straight handle sits above a separate espresso cup and saucer. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
